title: Station, to go, -age is masculine
summary: aller = to go: Je dois aller à la gare. la gare = the station, la ville = the city. -age words are masculine even though they end in e: le village, le garage, le message, le mariage (exception: la cage). Noun endings change meaning and gender from one base: la ville / le village / la villa.
points: aller = to go (like 'alleyway'). à la gare = to the station.
In the plural, la also becomes les: les gares, les villes.
-age is a masculine ending: le village, le garage, le message, le bagage, le courage, le mariage.
Exceptions to learn: la cage, la plage, la page, l'image.
One base, different endings: la ville / le village / la villa, la colle (glue) / le collage.
Remove the ending to find related words: le mariage → le mari (husband), l'avantage → avant (before), le courage → le cœur (heart).
